items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Well, who's late?' Bob Dorsett's(?) late, Ike Quebec's late.

ctx.x: say just 'Fuck it, I'll take my time to get up.' And when I get down there, the band's on stage. He said, 'Well, who's late?' Bob Dorsett's(?) late, Ike Quebec's late. And it's a bitch when you open up a stage, and then you got a half a band and all them empty seats. And man, he was furious behind that shit. When payday comes, it's right there. Boom, Cab fined you when you were late, twenty dollars. I said, 'Well, I'm gonna put it in my nose.'
But I wanted to do something with Lu, my wife. I wanted to stay there. I figured this is a chance for her career, you know. She had been interested in Jazz...
